findings: The book writes 'thus insulin kills bacteria' (penicillin) and 'dehydrogenase succinate' (succinate dehydrogenase); both corrected in a warning. It equates non-competitive with irreversible inhibition; the lesson reports this as the book's treatment.

The cobra box says PLA2 disrupts 'the cell wall of the red blood cell'; red blood cells have membranes, not walls. The Quick Check questions are printed without answers; the lesson's answers were derived for it and need the second-person review.
